name: q-bench2
description:
This is the benchmark dataset for "A Benchmark for Multi-modal Foundation Models on Low-level Vision: from Single Images to Pairs"
	


	
		
		The structure of the jsonl files is as follows:
	


q-bench2-a1-dev.jsonl (with img_path, question, answer_candidates, correct_answer)
q-bench2-a1-test.jsonl (with img_path, question, answer_candidates, without correct_answer)
q-bench2-a2.jsonl (with img_path, empty response)


	
		
	
	
		The img_path is organized as prefix + img1 + _cat_ + img2… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/q-future/q-bench2.
reputation: A recently released multimodal low-level vision benchmark with growing but still niche use in model evaluation.
